cohorts.verdict: 8/8 VERIFIED after the structural-exclusivity follow-up (root_instruction derivable solely via model_spec provenance; re-audited faithful by the original blind auditor). Known-defect set across all audited cohorts: EMPTY.

cohorts.cohort: bulk-chunk-02 (first chunk under the fully amended prompt; assert-bearing stratum)
cohorts.verdict: Below the 85% floor on the hard stratum, BUT the fix-loop classes are GONE (zero inversions, zero voided derivations, zero sibling imports — auditor confirmed correct sibling exclusion twice). Residual classes are narrower and 2/3 machine-catchable: only-exclusivity (M29 added, fires on the instance), should->oblige strengthening (M28 extended, fires), partial conditional scoping (read-required). Per Matt's option-A regime (detection net + repair pipeline bounding a residual rate), the run CONTINUES and defectives enter the frontier-repair queue; FM23 teaches the only-pair to chunk 4 onward.

3/3 VERIFIED after one softening follow-up (the verifier caught the repair over-correcting 'should only' into must-not+cnpa; fixed to the n022 soft-prohibition precedent and re-verified). Chunk-2 cohort seals at 6/6: 3 faithful as drafted + 3 repaired-and-verified. Known-defect set: EMPTY again.

Fix-loop classes still absent (no derivation-voiding, no sibling imports). Residuals: one prefer-FOR-dispreferred-act inversion in should-not clothing (M28 extended to catch 'should not' vs prefer/permit), one should->must escalation via cnpa (repair per the n022 soft-prohibition precedent), one scope loss (ChatGPT-only commitment generalized) + dropped developer-trust default, one dropped anti-sway claim. All four in frontier repair; run continues per option-A regime.

note_on_92pct: the 92.3% new-prompt figure came from the 14-redraw cohort, which was biased toward simple structural/heading nodes; chunk 0 shows complex conditional/agentic clauses run far lower. Quote the per-cohort numbers, never a single rate.
